identity.intro: Create your administrator account. Your organization becomes active after you verify your email.
identity.websiteHint: Use your HTTPS root website, e.g. https://company.com.
identity.passwordHint: Use 10–128 characters, including at least one uppercase letter and one special character.
identity.roleHint: Your professional role does not affect your administrator access.
identity.correctFields: Please correct the required fields above.
identity.unavailable: The service could not complete the request. Check your connection and try again.
identity.rolesError: The professional roles could not be loaded.
identity.pending: Our email provider has accepted the verification email. Check your inbox and spam folder. Delivery may take a few minutes. Use the latest link; it expires after 24 hours.
identity.verifiedHint: Your email is verified. Opening your organization…
identity.verifyHint: Your verification link signs you in and opens your organization automatically.
identity.invalidLink: This link is missing or invalid. Open the full link from your latest email, or request a new one below.
identity.cooldown: You can request another email in {{seconds}} seconds.
identity.adminReady: You are the organization administrator. Team invitations and member management will be available in a later update.
identity.loginRequired: Log in with a verified account to access your organization.
identity.failedDelivery: The last email attempt failed. We will retry automatically. An earlier link, if any, is unchanged.
identity.queued: Your registration is saved and your verification email is queued. We will send it shortly. Your organization remains inactive until you verify your email.
identity.deliveryCancelled: This email request is no longer available. Log in if you have verified your account, or register with another organization.
identity.emailLocked: This is the email saved with your registration. It cannot be changed here.

errors.password: Create a password with at least 10 characters, one uppercase letter, and one special character.

invitations.title: Bring your team together.
invitations.denied: Log in as a verified organization administrator to invite team members.
invitations.eyebrow: A shared space starts with your people
invitations.intro: Invite colleagues to your organization, one email at a time. Work or personal addresses are welcome.
invitations.formHint: All you need is their email address.
invitations.invalid: Enter a valid email address, up to 254 characters.
invitations.failed: The invitation could not be sent. Please try again.
invitations.uncertain: We could not confirm the result. Check the send status before trying again. If it remains in progress, contact support.
invitations.footer: Invitations expire after seven days. Your colleague will set up their own account when they accept. Pending invitations do not reserve an active-account slot.
invitations.pendingHint: Resending and managing pending invitations will be available in a future update. Your existing invitation remains unchanged.
invitations.loadFailed: We could not load your account. Please try again.
invitations.historyHint: Saved invitations for your organization, newest first.
invitations.historyError: Previous invitations could not be loaded. Please try again.

acceptance.title: Make yourself at home.
acceptance.intro: Accept your invitation and start your next chapter with your team.
acceptance.invalid: This invitation is invalid. Please contact the organization administrator for a valid invitation.
acceptance.loadFailed: We could not check your invitation. Please try again.
acceptance.uncertain: We could not confirm registration. Check the invitation status before trying again. If it was accepted, log in with the password you just chose.
acceptance.welcome: Your account is active and you are signed in to {{company}}.
acceptance.bound: This email and organization come from your invitation and cannot be changed.
acceptance.nameError: Enter your full name, up to 200 characters.

team.title: Manage your team
team.intro: See who has joined your company and follow up on invitations.
team.scrollHint: Scroll horizontally to see all details.
team.loadFailed: Records could not be loaded. Please retry.
team.uncertain: The resend outcome could not be confirmed. Refresh the list before retrying; the previous link remains valid until a replacement is confirmed.
team.noInvitationsHint: Invite a colleague to start building your team.
team.noMembersHint: Colleagues will appear here after completing registration.

knowledge.title: Your knowledge workspace.
knowledge.intro: Keep the context. Share the treasure.
knowledge.titleHint: Give your knowledge a clear, recognizable name.
knowledge.captureHint: What are you capturing, and why is it worth keeping?

guidance.Knowledge: Explain the insight, its context, and when it is useful.
guidance.Coding: Include a nonempty code block and explain how to use it.
guidance.Problem: Describe what happened, what you investigated, and what you learned.
guidance.Decision: Explain the decision, alternatives, and reasoning.
guidance.Accomplishment: Describe what you achieved and its impact.
guidance.Learning: Explain what you learned and how to apply it.

knowledge.aiHint: Rephrase existing Title or Capture wording independently. Keep the same meaning and a similar length. Enter text in a field before refining it.
knowledge.autoAttributes: Attributes are added automatically after publishing.
knowledge.polishIntro: Polish only what you wrote in Title or Capture. Suggestions stay concise and preserve your meaning.
knowledge.attributeHint: Added after publishing. Keep writing naturally.
knowledge.externalAi: Refinement sends only the selected field to OpenAI. Automatic classification sends the full ticket content after publication. Do not include sensitive information.
knowledge.leave: Leave without publishing? Your unsaved writing will be lost.
knowledge.success: Ticket published. Your organization can read it now.
knowledge.unavailable: The request could not finish. Your writing is preserved. Please retry.
knowledge.retryHint: Your content is preserved. If publication is uncertain, editing is paused; retry to safely retrieve the same published ticket.
knowledge.TICKET_NOT_FOUND: This ticket is unavailable in your organization.
knowledge.browseIntro: Useful context, shared by your organization.
knowledge.filteredEmpty: No tickets of this type yet
knowledge.browseError: Knowledge could not be loaded. Please retry.
knowledge.detailRefreshError: This ticket could not be refreshed. The loaded content is still available. Please retry.
